name: Blood Zone 🎃
desc:
💥 Have some fun in this awesome FFA pvp shooter game!

🩸 Step foot into this game, it's just pure chaos. Just kill, kill, and kill. Customize your character with some fashion as you mow your enemies down! Also features a large catalog of weapons and secrets to put your grubby little hands on!

✅ MAKE SURE to turn blood on in the settings for the full experience
❌ Do NOT farm for kills / deaths for an unfair advantage, it is a punishable offense!

Most Recent Update:

🎃 The Halloween event is here! Search for golden pumpkin and special candies to earn limited rewards!
✨ Use code "halloween2026" for a free skin!

👍 Remember to like and favorite!
